jobs.title: About us
jobs.description: Orca AI - Pioneers in Autonomous Maritime Navigation Platform SeaPod For the bridge FleetView For the office Co-Captain For the bridge MasterView For the master Perception for autonomous vessels Solutions Situational Awareness GPS Spoofing Crew Training Industries Commercial Shipping Resources Blog Press Releases Case Studies Glossary News Videos FAQs Reports Company About Partners Careers Events Log in Contact us Platform SeaPod For the bridge FleetView For the office Co-Captain For the bridge MasterView For the master Perception for autonomous vessels Solutions Situational Awareness GPS Spoofing Crew Training Industries Commercial Shipping Resources Blog Press Releases Case Studies Glossary News Videos FAQs Reports Company About Partners Careers Events Contact us Rethinking shipping operations Our Mission Orca AI is on a mission to empower shipping with data-driven technologies and the automation needed for navigating the safest voyages with the most efficient operations. Management Team Dor Raviv CTO & Co-founder Yarden Gross CEO & Co-founder Shoval Bolotin COO Fabrizio Ferraro VP Commercial and Partnership Lirit Belisha CFO Amit Zilberberg VP R&D Keren Raiten VP Marketing Omer Winkler VP Product Debbie Diamond VP People Our Story The story of Orca AI begins 15 years ago, when our co-founders Yarden Gross and Dor Raviv met. They engrossed in a discussion about the profound impact autonomy, AI, and computer vision are making on the mobility, satellite, and aviation industries. What if we could bring the power of AI and computer vision to the maritime industry? Fast forward to 2018, when they founded Orca AI, inspired by the vision to bring the shipping industry to the digital age and to lay the foundation for global adoption of smart, fully autonomous ships. Today, Orca AI is moving fast with our robust team of maritime veterans, computer vision experts, deep learning engineers, creators, and doers, who are all driven by the mission to make ships smarter, to empower industry leaders to rethink shipping operations, and to be a leading force in spearheading the shipping revolution. Investors Help shape the future of shipping! Orca AI is always on the lookout for top talent. If you love the ocean and have a passion for challenging existing maritime paradigms, check out our open positions and apply. View careers Capt. Rajesh Unni Founder & CEO of Synergy Marine Group; Co-CEO of Alpha Ori Group Capt. Rajesh Unni is the founder & CEO of Synergy Marine Group and Co-CEO of Alpha Ori Group. In a career spanning over 25 years in shipping, he has served in various roles across countries. He is driven by a vision to transform the maritime industry through technology and innovation. He is a Class 1 Master Mariner from the LBS College of Advanced Maritime Studies & Research, Mumbai. He sits on the boards of the Global Maritime Forum, the North of England and is the Vice-Chair at Maritime Anti-Corruption Network. He is a thought partner with one of the largest not-for-profit organization called Ashoka, and is a Trustee of the Cochin Cancer Society. Dor Raviv CTO & Co-founder Dor Raviv is an accomplished skipper, AI algorithms engineer, and maritime navigation instructor. Led autonomous ship projects and managed multidisciplinary teams in top AI startups. Dor is currently responsible for leading Orca AI’s cutting-edge technology and products Holds a B.Sc in Industrial Engineering and management, specializing in deep learning pipelines and data science. Yarden Gross CEO & Co-founder Yarden Gross is an experienced entrepreneur with vast knowledge and experience in maritime technologies. He currently spearheads Orca AI’s vision to make autonomous commercial shipping a reality. Before founding Orca AI, he was the co-founder and CEO of Engie, a VC-backed automotive tech company. He holds a BA in Economics and Business from Reichman University (IDC Herzliya). Shoval Bolotin COO Shoval Bolotin is an experienced business manager with a proven track record of leading product management, marketing, and global service operations. Before joining Orca AI, Shoval gained tremendous amounts of experience in some of Israel’s leading companies, such as RAD Data Communications, NICE Systems, and several startups. But perhaps nothing prepared him more for his current role than the IDF Navy, where he rose to the rank of submarine captain and graduated from the Israeli Naval Academy. Shoval holds an MBA from The College of Management and BSs in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from Tel Aviv University. Fabrizio Ferraro VP Commercial and Partnership Fabrizio Ferraro brings over a decade of experience in industrial, consulting, and enterprise technology roles to Orca AI. An engineer by training, Fabrizio has lived and worked across Europe and APAC, building his career around a clear focus: bringing digitalization and AI into heavy industries and ensuring those technologies work in real operational environments. His path includes time at Boston Consulting Group (BCG) and seven years at Samsara, where he joined early and helped scale the business from pre-IPO to global reach, working hands-on with fleets to roll out safety technology used day to day. Fabrizio holds an MBA from INSEAD and a second level Master in Industrial Automation from Politecnico di Torino. Born and raised in Naples and a sailor himself, he brings a personal connection to maritime operations as he leads Orca AI’s global sales efforts. Lirit Belisha CFO An experienced CFO with a demonstrated history of driving financial success in multinational corporations. With over 20 years of experience, Lirit has a proven track record of leading successful fundraising and M&A, implementing cost-saving strategies and playing a key role in strategic planning and business development. Lirit is recognized for her collaborative leadership style and innovative approach. Prior to joining ORCA AI Lirit served as CFO of several startup companies across various industries

jobs.description: Dor Raviv, Co-founder, CTO | Orca AI Careers Dor Raviv, Co-founder, CTO Dor Raviv · Co-founder, CTO Orca AI Dor Raviv, Co-founder and CTO of Orca AI, draws on a life-changing experience at sea to fuel his passion for enhancing maritime safety. During a tense night watch with his father, he narrowly avoided a collision with a commercial ship, inspiring him to develop technology that aids navigators in overcoming similar challenges. At Orca AI, Dor leads a dedicated team committed to innovating solutions that transform how vessels interact with their surroundings, ensuring safer and more efficient journeys across the world's oceans. His personal commitment to maritime safety is the driving force behind the company's pioneering advancements. Show full transcript » Hide transcript Full transcript Middle of the night pitch black darkness all you can see are the stars above your head and all of a sudden I see a light the horizon coming to hold us a few years ago I traveled with my dad on Sailing vessel and in the middle of the night. I was in charge of the night shifts when it was Cold and high waves and high seas. I saw light at the horizon And it came towards us and I didn't really know what to do I decided eventually to wake up my dad and ask him like what should we do the light is really nearby us and He like the very last second. He altered the home and we avoided a massive collision with a huge commercial ship That was the moment. I knew I had to start a company that helps Navigatos deal with such frightening challenges and that's work.
